blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Heat and Thermodynamics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases

blocks.prompt:
1 What is thermodynamics? Why does it play a key role in technology?
(Thermodynamics kya hai? Technology mein is ka aham kirdar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermodynamics physics ki woh shaakh hai jo heat (hararat) aur energy ki doosri shaklon ke taalluq aur tabdeeli se bahas karti hai. Technology mein aham hai kyunke hamare istemal ki taqreeban saari kham energy heat ki shakal mein nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: deals with the relationships and conversions between heat and other forms of energy

blocks.prompt:
2 What does the kinetic theory of gases explain?
(Kinetic theory of gases kis cheez ki wazahat karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetic theory of gases gas ke rawayye ko us ke zarraat (particles) ki harkat ki buniyad par samjhati hai. Yeh pressure, temperature aur volume jaisi khususiyaat ko zarraat ki harkat se jorti hai.

book_ref.quote: explains the behaviour of gases based on the motion of their constituent particles

blocks.prompt:
3 Why are gas molecules treated as point masses in the kinetic theory?
(Kinetic theory mein gas molecules ko point masses kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke alag alag molecules ka volume gas ke kul volume ke muqable mein na-qabil-e-lehaaz (negligible) hai. Is liye zarraat ko aise point masses mana jata hai jin ka koi qabil-e-zikr volume nahi.

book_ref.quote: The volume of the individual gas molecules is negligible compared to the total volume of the gas.

blocks.prompt:
4 What is meant by saying that the collisions of gas molecules are perfectly elastic?
(Gas molecules ki takkar perfectly elastic hone ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecules ki aapas mein aur deewaron se takkar mein kinetic energy ka koi kul nuqsan nahi hota. Har takkar mein molecules ki kul kinetic energy mehfooz (conserved) rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Collisions between gas molecules, and between molecules and walls of the container are perfectly elastic.

blocks.prompt:
5 How does a gas exert pressure on the walls of its container according to the kinetic theory?
(Kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas apne bartan ki deewaron par pressure kaise dalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas ke zarraat musalsal bartan ki deewaron se takrate hain. In takkaron ke dauran zarraat ki force gas ka pressure paida karti hai.

book_ref.quote: The force exerted by the particles during collisions generates pressure.

blocks.prompt:
6 Why do gas particles move faster when the gas is heated?
(Gas garam karne par us ke zarraat tez kyun harkat karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gas ke zarraat ki average kinetic energy absolute temperature ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai. Garam karne se temperature barhta hai, is liye average kinetic energy aur speed barh jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: This implies that as the temperature increases

blocks.prompt:
7 State one limitation of the kinetic molecular theory.
(Kinetic molecular theory ki aik had (limitation) bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Is ke mafroozat sirf ideal gases par poore utarte hain. Real gases intermolecular forces aur molecules ke mehdood volume ki wajah se, khaas taur par zyada pressure aur kam temperature par, farq dikhati hain.

book_ref.quote: real gases exhibit deviations due to intermolecular forces and finite molecular volume

blocks.prompt:
8 What is an ideal gas? Write its equation of state and name each symbol.
(Ideal gas kya hai? Us ki equation of state likhein aur har symbol ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Jo gas kinetic theory ki pairwi kare woh ideal gas hai. Us ki equation of state PV = nRT hai: P pressure, V volume, n moles ki tadaad, R universal gas constant (8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) aur T absolute temperature.

book_ref.quote: A gas that obeys kinetic theory of gases is termed as an ideal gas

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the volume occupied by 0.50 mol of an ideal gas at 400 K and 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa.
(0.50 mol ideal gas 400 K aur 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa par kitna volume gherti hai?)

book_ref.quote: R is universal gas constant (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) and T is the temperature.

blocks.prompt:
10 Define the Boltzmann constant and find its value from R and Nₐ.
(Boltzmann constant ki definition likhein aur R aur Nₐ se us ki qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Boltzmann constant universal gas constant aur Avogadro's number ki nisbat hai: k_B = R/Nₐ = 8.3145/(6.02 × 10²³) = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: The term R/Nₐ is termed as Boltzmann constant k_B.

blocks.prompt:
11 How many moles are there in 3.01 × 10²³ molecules of a gas? (Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³)
(Gas ke 3.01 × 10²³ molecules mein kitne moles hain? (Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³))

book_ref.quote: Here n represents number of moles of the ideal gas.

blocks.prompt:
12 Write the ideal gas equation in terms of the Boltzmann constant. What does N stand for in it?
(Boltzmann constant ki shakal mein ideal gas equation likhein. Is mein N kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PV = N k_B T (Eq. 6.3). N gas ke molecules (ya atoms) ki kul tadaad hai, N = nNₐ. Yeh PV = nRT mein n = N/Nₐ aur k_B = R/Nₐ rakhne se milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Equation (6.3) gives ideal gas equation in terms of Boltzmann constant.

blocks.prompt:
13 Under what conditions does a real gas approach ideal behaviour?
(Real gas kin halaat mein ideal rawayye ke qareeb aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam pressure aur zyada temperature par. Us waqt density kam hoti hai, molecules door door hote hain aur intermolecular forces na hone ke barabar, is liye gas ideal ki tarah rawayya rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Real gases approach ideal behaviour under: (i) low pressure (ii) high temperature

blocks.prompt:
14 Show that the density of an ideal gas is ρ = PM/RT.
(Sabit karein ke ideal gas ki density ρ = PM/RT hai.)
blocks.explanation: Moles n = m/M, is liye PV = (m/M)RT. Tarteeb dene se PM = (m/V)RT. Chunke density ρ = m/V, is liye PM = ρRT, yani ρ = PM/RT aur ρ ∝ P/T.

book_ref.quote: In Eq. (6.1) n represents number of moles which can be given by

blocks.prompt:
15 Find the density of nitrogen (M = 0.028 kg mol⁻¹) at 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa and 280 K, treating it as an ideal gas.
(Nitrogen (M = 0.028 kg mol⁻¹) ko ideal gas maan kar 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa aur 280 K par us ki density nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For a real gas to behave like an ideal gas, some conditions must be satisfied.

blocks.prompt:
16 State Boyle's law and write it mathematically.
(Boyle's law bayan karein aur riyazi shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sabit temperature par ideal gas ki muqarrara miqdaar ka pressure volume ke ulat (inversely) mutanasib hai: P ∝ 1/V, ya PV = constant, ya P₁V₁ = P₂V₂.

book_ref.quote: provides a relationship between pressure and volume of a gas at constant temperature

blocks.prompt:
17 A gas occupies 5.0 L at 1.2 × 10⁵ Pa. Find its pressure when it is compressed to 3.0 L at constant temperature.
(Aik gas 1.2 × 10⁵ Pa par 5.0 L gherti hai. Sabit temperature par 3.0 L tak dabane par us ka pressure nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Boyle's law: P₂ = P₁V₁/V₂ = (1.2 × 10⁵ × 5.0)/3.0 = 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa.

book_ref.quote: Boyle's law is shown graphically in Fig. 6.1.

blocks.prompt:
18 State Charles' law and write it mathematically.
(Charles' law bayan karein aur riyazi shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sabit pressure par gas ki di gayi miqdaar ka volume us ke absolute temperature ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai: V ∝ T, ya V/T = constant, ya V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂.

book_ref.quote: It is stated that the volume of given mass of gas at constant pressure

blocks.prompt:
19 A gas occupies 250 cm³ at 7 °C. Find its volume at 77 °C if the pressure stays constant.
(Aik gas 7 °C par 250 cm³ gherti hai. Pressure sabit rahe to 77 °C par us ka volume nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Charles' law relates volume and temperature of an ideal gas for a fixed mass at constant pressure.

blocks.prompt:
20 A tyre contains air at 2.4 × 10⁵ Pa at 27 °C. Assuming constant volume, find the pressure when the air warms to 47 °C.
(Tyre mein 27 °C par 2.4 × 10⁵ Pa ki hawa hai. Volume sabit maan kar 47 °C par pressure nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Gay-Lussac's law: P₂ = P₁T₂/T₁, T₁ = 300 K, T₂ = 320 K. P₂ = 2.4 × 10⁵ × 320/300 = 2.56 × 10⁵ Pa.

book_ref.quote: the pressure exerted by a gas varies directly with absolute temperature of the gas at constant volume

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between Boyle's law and Charles' law.
(Boyle's law aur Charles' law mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Boyle's law sabit T par P aur V ko jorta hai; Charles' law sabit P par V aur T ko.

book_ref.quote: There are some variables (state functions) that describe quantity of gas

rows: Pressure aur volume ko jorta hai.
Volume aur absolute temperature ko jorta hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between an ideal gas and a real gas.
(Ideal gas aur real gas mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ideal gas kinetic theory ki poori pairwi karti hai; real gas us se hat-ti hai.

book_ref.quote: The assumptions of the kinetic theory hold true for ideal gases

rows: Kinetic theory ki pairwi karti hai.
Us se hat-ti hai, khaas taur par zyada pressure aur kam temperature par.
Molecules ka mehdood volume hota hai.
Molecules ki sirf K.E.; P.E. na hone ke barabar.
Sirf kam pressure aur zyada temperature par ideal jaisi.

blocks.prompt:
23 A metal spoon is placed in a cup of hot coffee. Describe how thermal equilibrium is reached.
(Garam coffee ke cup mein dhaat ka chamach rakha jata hai. Batayein ke thermal equilibrium kaise hasil hota hai.)
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein coffee chamach se garam hai, is liye heat coffee se chamach ki taraf behti hai. Aakhir dono ka temperature barabar ho jata hai; phir heat ka koi kul bahao nahi hota aur woh thermal equilibrium mein hote hain.

book_ref.quote: When we put a metal spoon into a hot cup of coffee:

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is the internal energy of an ideal gas only the translational K.E. of its molecules?
(Ideal gas ki internal energy sirf us ke molecules ki translational K.E. kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ideal gas ke molecules sirf mass points hain jo aik doosre par koi force nahi lagate, is liye un ki P.E. nahi hoti. Lihaza ideal gas ki internal energy aam taur par molecules ki translational K.E. hai.

book_ref.quote: The molecules of an ideal gas are mere mass points which exert no forces on one another.

blocks.prompt:
25 What forms of energy does a diatomic gas molecule have?
(Diatomic gas molecule mein energy ki kaun si shaklein hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Diatomic molecule mein translational aur rotational energy hoti hai. Is ke do atoms ke darmiyan spring jaise bond ki vibrational energy bhi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: vibrational energy associated with the spring like bond between its atoms.

blocks.prompt:
26 Find the average kinetic energy of a gas molecule at 27 °C. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹)
(27 °C par gas molecule ki average kinetic energy nikalein. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: the average kinetic energy of gas molecules is given by

blocks.prompt:
27 Why does the temperature of an object rise when it absorbs heat?
(Heat jazb karne par kisi cheez ka temperature kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jazb shuda heat zarraat ki average kinetic energy barha kar internal energy barhati hai. Temperature ka barhna isi androoni kinetic energy ke izafe ko zahir karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This increase in internal energy can occur due to the absorption of heat energy

blocks.prompt:
28 Name three processes that can change the internal energy of a system.
(Teen aise amal ke naam likhein jo system ki internal energy badal sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Garam karna (heat dena). (2) Adiabatic dabao ya phailao, jis mein heat ka len den nahi. (3) Phase ki tabdeeli, jis mein heat temperature badle baghair halat badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Different processes can lead to changes in internal energy and temperature

blocks.prompt:
29 Why is internal energy called a function of state?
(Internal energy ko function of state kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh ikhtiyar kiye gaye raaste par nahi balke sirf system ki ibtidai aur aakhri halat par munhasir hai. Gravitational P.E. ki tarah sirf internal energy ki tabdeeli aham hai, mukammal qeemat nahi.

book_ref.quote: Consequently, it does not depend on path but depends on initial and final states of the system.

blocks.prompt:
30 State the sign convention for work in thermodynamics. Why was it chosen?
(Thermodynamics mein work ka sign convention bayan karein. Yeh kyun chuna gaya?)
blocks.explanation: System ka mahaul par kiya gaya work musbat hai; mahaul ka system par kiya gaya work manfi hai. Yeh steam engine se aaya jahan heat andar jaati aur work bahar aata hai, is liye dono musbat liye gaye.

book_ref.quote: Consequently, it made a sense to define both heat in and work out as positive quantities.

blocks.prompt:
31 What can happen to an amount of heat Q that enters a system?
(System mein dakhil hone wali heat Q ka kya ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh system ki internal energy mein izafa ban sakti hai, ya system ka mahaul par kiya gaya work, ya dono.

book_ref.quote: it could manifest itself as either an increase in internal energy

blocks.prompt:
32 A gas at a constant pressure of 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa expands from 2.0 L to 5.0 L. Find the work done by the gas.
(1.0 × 10⁵ Pa ke sabit pressure par aik gas 2.0 L se 5.0 L tak phailti hai. Gas ka kiya gaya work nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: ΔV = 5.0 − 2.0 = 3.0 L = 3.0 × 10⁻³ m³. W = PΔV = 1.0 × 10⁵ × 3.0 × 10⁻³ = 300 J (gas ka kiya hua, musbat).

book_ref.quote: Consider the gas enclosed in the cylinder with a moveable, frictionless piston

blocks.prompt:
33 What are the laws of thermodynamics?
(Thermodynamics ke qawaneen kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh woh aam usool hain jo heat energy aur us ki mechanical energy mein tabdeeli se mutaliq hain. In ki buniyad internal energy ki tabdeeli aur mechanical work par hai.

book_ref.quote: Knowing the details of the change in internal energy and the mechanical work done

blocks.prompt:
34 State the first law of thermodynamics and write its equation.
(First law of thermodynamics bayan karein aur us ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi bhi thermodynamic amal mein jab system ko heat Q di jaye to yeh system mein jama internal energy ke izafe ΔU aur system ke mahaul par kiye gaye work W ki shakal mein zahir hoti hai: Q = ΔU + W.

book_ref.quote: In any thermodynamic process, when heat Q is added to a system

blocks.prompt:
35 Show that the first law of thermodynamics is a statement of conservation of energy.
(Dikhayein ke first law of thermodynamics energy ki baqa (conservation of energy) ka bayan hai.)
blocks.explanation: Q = ΔU + W batata hai ke di gayi heat poori ki poori internal energy aur work mein shumar hoti hai; na koi energy paida hoti hai na khatam. Energy sirf shakal badalti hai aur isolated system ki kul energy sabit rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: The first law of thermodynamics expresses the law of conservation of energy

blocks.prompt:
36 Why is the first law of thermodynamics said to have wider applicability?
(First law of thermodynamics ko wasee istemal wala kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mechanical systems ke ilawa yeh energy ki tamam shaklon aur har qisam ke amal par laagu hai, jaise chemical reactions, electrical systems aur nuclear reactions, aur in mein energy ki tabdeeli samajhne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: the first law of thermodynamics applies universally to all forms of energy

blocks.prompt:
37 A gas absorbs 120 J of heat and its internal energy increases by 45 J. How much work does the gas do?
(Aik gas 120 J heat jazb karti hai aur us ki internal energy 45 J barhti hai. Gas kitna work karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q = ΔU + W, is liye W = Q − ΔU = 120 − 45 = 75 J (gas ne mahaul par kiya).

book_ref.quote: A gas is enclosed in a container fitted with a piston of cross-sectional area 0.10 m².

blocks.prompt:
38 Explain why the air in a bicycle pump with a blocked outlet gets hot when the piston is pushed rapidly.
(Band outlet wale cycle pump ka piston tezi se dabane par hawa garam kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dhakelne wali force hawa par work karti hai. Heat ko nikalne ka waqt nahi milta, is liye yeh work hawa ki internal energy barhata hai, jo thermocouple par temperature ke izafe se nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: One such simple arrangement is shown in Fig. 6.6.

blocks.prompt:
39 How does the first law of thermodynamics apply to the human body?
(First law of thermodynamics insani jism par kaise laagu hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jism par ΔU = Q − W lagayein: chalne, daurne ya harkat mein kiya gaya work jism ki internal energy kam karta hai. Hamara khana internal energy aur jism ka temperature barqarar rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Human metabolism also provides an example of energy conservation.

blocks.prompt:
40 What is an isothermal process? Which gas law applies to it?
(Isothermal amal kya hai? Is par kaun sa gas law laagu hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sabit temperature par hone wala amal isothermal hai. T sabit hone ki wajah se Boyle's law laagu hota hai: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂. Is ka P-V curve isotherm kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: hence the condition for the application of Boyle's law on the gas is fulfilled

blocks.prompt:
41 Why does the internal energy of an ideal gas remain constant during an isothermal expansion?
(Isothermal phailao ke dauran ideal gas ki internal energy sabit kyun rehti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ideal gas ke molecules ki P.E. sifar hai, is liye internal energy sirf temperature par munhasir hai. Isothermal amal mein temperature sabit hai, is liye ΔU = 0 aur Q = W.

book_ref.quote: Why does the internal energy of an ideal gas remain constant during isothermal expansion?

blocks.prompt:
42 An ideal gas is compressed isothermally by doing 400 J of work on it. How much heat leaves the gas?
(Ideal gas par 400 J work kar ke use isothermal tor par dabaya jata hai. Gas se kitni heat nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Isothermal: ΔU = 0, is liye Q = W = −400 J (gas par kiya work manfi). Q manfi hai: 400 J heat gas se nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus if gas expands and does external work W

blocks.prompt:
43 What is an adiabatic process? Write the first law for it.
(Adiabatic amal kya hai? Is ke liye first law likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jis amal mein heat na system mein aaye na nikle woh adiabatic hai. ΔQ = 0 se first law W = −ΔU deta hai: gas ka work us ki internal energy se aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, ΔQ = 0 and the first law of thermodynamics gives

blocks.prompt:
44 Why does the temperature of a gas fall when it expands adiabatically?
(Adiabatic phailao mein gas ka temperature kyun girta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heat andar nahi aati, is liye gas ka bairooni work us ke molecules ki internal energy ke kharch par hota hai (W = −ΔU). Internal energy kam hoti hai, is liye temperature girta hai.

book_ref.quote: hence, the temperature of the gas falls

blocks.prompt:
45 Give three examples of adiabatic processes.
(Adiabatic amal ki teen misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Phate tyre se hawa ka tezi se nikalna. (2) Aawaz ki lehar guzarne par hawa ka tezi se phailna aur dabna. (3) Fizaa mein badal banna.

book_ref.quote: The rapid expansion and compression of air through which a sound wave is passing.

blocks.prompt:
46 A gas in an insulated cylinder is compressed rapidly by doing 150 J of work on it. Find the change in its internal energy.
(Insulated cylinder mein gas par 150 J work kar ke use tezi se dabaya jata hai. Us ki internal energy mein tabdeeli nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Adiabatic: Q = 0, W = −150 J (gas par work). ΔU = Q − W = 0 − (−150) = +150 J, is liye gas ka temperature barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: An adiabatic process is the one in which no heat enters or leaves the system.

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between an isothermal and an adiabatic process.
(Isothermal aur adiabatic amal mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Isothermal amal mein temperature sabit; adiabatic amal mein heat ka len den nahi.

book_ref.quote: In case of an ideal gas, the P.E. associated with its molecules is zero

rows: Heat na aati hai na jaati hai (ΔQ = 0).
Aahista hota hai taake heat muntaqil ho sake.
Tezi se hota hai, aam tor par insulated cylinder mein.

blocks.prompt:
48 What happens to heat and work at each stage when a reversible process is run backwards?
(Jab reversible amal ulta chalaya jaye to har marhale par heat aur work ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Substance unhi marhalon se ulti tarteeb mein guzarta hai aur tamam asraat bilkul ulat jaate hain: jazb hui heat kharij hoti hai aur substance ka kiya work us par kiya work ban jata hai. Substance apni asal halat mein wapas aa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence, the working substance is restored to its original conditions.

blocks.prompt:
49 What is a cycle? When is a cycle called reversible?
(Cycle kya hai? Cycle ko reversible kab kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Waqiaat ka woh silsila jo system ko wapas ibtidai halat mein le aaye cycle kehlata hai. Reversible cycle woh hai jis ki tamam tabdeeliyan reversible hon.

book_ref.quote: A reversible cycle is the one in which all the changes are reversible.

blocks.prompt:
50 Give two examples each of practically reversible and irreversible processes.
(Amalan reversible aur irreversible amal ki do do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Amalan reversible: maadde ka aahista liquefaction ya evaporation; cylinder mein gas ka aahista dabna. Irreversible: dhamaka; ragar ya conduction, convection ya radiation se heat zaya karne wali tabdeeliyan.

book_ref.quote: Similarly the slow compression of a gas in a cylinder is reversible process

blocks.prompt:
51 What is a heat engine? Which observation led to the steam engine?
(Heat engine kya hai? Kis mushahide se steam engine bana?)
blocks.explanation: Heat engine kuch thermal energy, aam tor par jalte fuel se, mechanical work mein badalta hai. Dhake bartan mein paani ubalne par bhaap dhakkan ko dhakelti hai, jo work ki salahiyat dikhata hai; is se steam engine bana.

book_ref.quote: This observation helped to develop a steam engine.

blocks.prompt:
52 State the working principle of a heat engine.
(Heat engine ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Heat engine aik dauri (cyclic) amal mein kaam karta hai jis mein heat zyada temperature wale reservoir se kam temperature wale reservoir ki taraf jaati hai aur us ka zyada se zyada hissa mechanical work banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The working principle of a heat engine is based on the conversion of heat energy into mechanical work

blocks.prompt:
53 Why was the second law of thermodynamics needed when we already have the first law?
(Jab first law mojood tha to second law of thermodynamics ki zaroorat kyun pari?)
blocks.explanation: First law kehta hai ke heat barabar work mein badal sakti hai magar sharait ke baare mein khamosh hai. Second law batata hai ke heat kin halaat mein work banti hai aur heat ka bahao kis simt mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The second law is concerned with the circumstances in which heat can be converted into work

blocks.prompt:
54 An engine absorbs 1500 J of heat and does 450 J of work in one cycle. Find the heat expelled and its efficiency.
(Aik engine aik cycle mein 1500 J heat leta hai aur 450 J work karta hai. Kharij heat aur efficiency nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: W = Q₁ − Q₂, is liye Q₂ = 1500 − 450 = 1050 J. Efficiency = W/Q₁ = 450/1500 = 0.30 = 30%.

book_ref.quote: It does work W and expels heat Q₂ to low temperature reservoir at temperature T₂.

blocks.prompt:
55 Why can't a ship use the heat of the ocean to run its engine?
(Jahaz samandar ki heat se apna engine kyun nahi chala sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Second law ke mutabiq aik akela heat reservoir, chahe kitni energy rakhta ho, work nahi kar sakta. Engine ko kam temperature wala sink chahiye, aur samandar se thanda koi reservoir nahi jahan heat di ja sake.

book_ref.quote: This means that a single heat reservoir, no matter how much energy it contains

blocks.prompt:
56 What is a Carnot engine? Name the four steps of the Carnot cycle.
(Carnot engine kya hai? Carnot cycle ke chaar marhalon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik misali engine (Sadi Carnot, 1824) jo reversible cycle mein sirf isothermal aur adiabatic amal istemal karta hai. Marhale: AB T₁ par isothermal phailao; BC adiabatic phailao; CD T₂ par isothermal dabao; DA adiabatic dabao.

book_ref.quote: He showed that a heat engine operating in an ideal reversible cycle

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is the change in internal energy zero in one Carnot cycle?
(Aik Carnot cycle mein internal energy ki tabdeeli sifar kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cycle ke aakhir mein working substance apni ibtidai halat mein wapas aa jata hai. Internal energy sirf halat par munhasir hai, is liye ΔU = 0 aur kul work W = Q₁ − Q₂.

book_ref.quote: Thermal and mechanical equilibrium is maintained all the time so that each process is perfectly reversible.

blocks.prompt:
58 Find the efficiency of a Carnot engine working between 127 °C and 27 °C.
(127 °C aur 27 °C ke darmiyan chalne wale Carnot engine ki efficiency nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The turbine in a steam power plant takes steam from a boiler at 427 °C

blocks.prompt:
59 Why is the efficiency of a Carnot engine always less than 100%?
(Carnot engine ki efficiency hamesha 100% se kam kyun hoti hai?)
